Validate and reconcile declarative configuration

Usage:
  tanpopo config [flags]
  tanpopo config [command]

Available Commands:
  reconcile   Validate tanpopo.yaml and immutable tanpopo.lock, then apply atomically

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config

Global Flags:
      --lang string     Display language (auto or locale code such as en, vi, ja, zh-Hans) (default "auto")
      --output string   Output format (table|json|yaml) (default "table")

Use "tanpopo config [command] --help" for more information about a command.
